A 135
2019 Non-Biodegradable Waste Control (Plastic Food SRO. 30
Products) Order
GRENADA
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS NO. 30 OF 2019
THE Minister in exercise of the powers conferred on him by Section
3 (2) of the Non-Biodegradable Waste Control Act, No. 9 of 2018
hereby makes the following Order­­–
(Gazetted 8th November, 2019).
1. Citation. This Order may be cited as the–
NON-BIODEGRADABLE WASTE CONTROL (PLASTIC FOOD
PRODUCTS) ORDER, 2019.
2. Definitions. In this Order–
“Act” means the Non-Biodegradable Waste Control Act, No. 9 of 2018;
“cutlery” means a fork, spoon, spork or knife;
“food container” means a plate, cup, or glass;
“plastic food product” means any single-use food container, cutlery, or straw,
made of plastic and used in the sale or providing food for consumption,
and excludes plastic bags.
3. Designation of plastic food products. For the purposes of the Act, a plastic
food product is a non-biodegradable product.
4. Transitional provisions.—(1) Section 4 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect
to plastic food products from the 1st day of March, 2020.
(2) Section 5 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect to plastic food products
from the 1st day of September, 2020.
(3) Section 6 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect to plastic food products
from the 1st day of March, 2021.

SRO. 30 Non-Biodegradable Waste Control (Plastic Food 2019
Products) Order
Made by the Minister this 31st day of October, 2019.
SIMON STIELL
Minister with responsibility for the Environment.
Passed by the House of Representatives this 8th day of November, 2019.
ANDREW AUGUSTINE
